subject.title: fix(agents): pass attemptNumber instead of apiKeyIndex to retry callbacks (#102938)

question: Should the public provider-auth retry callback permanently expose `apiKeyIndex` and `attemptNumber` while deprecating the shipped `attempt` field?
rationale: The helper is exported through the plugin SDK, so field semantics and deprecation lifetime define an external compatibility contract that automation cannot choose.

options.title: Managed deprecation
options.body: Add both explicit fields, retain `attempt` as the key index, and document a maintainer-approved deprecation or removal policy with compatibility coverage.

options.title: No deprecation yet
options.body: Add both explicit fields but keep `attempt` supported without a removal signal until broader plugin-SDK versioning is decided.

options.title: Keep current contract
options.body: Decline the new callback metadata and require consumers to track retry state outside this helper.

recommendation.title: Managed deprecation
recommendation.body: Add both explicit fields, retain `attempt` as the key index, and document a maintainer-approved deprecation or removal policy with compatibility coverage.
